newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: China's Fujian refinery plans early April shutdown.
newsitem.headline: China's Fujian refinery plans early April shutdown.

text.p: China's southeastern Fujian refinery is scheduled to shut down in early April for maintenance, a refinery official said on Monday.
The 51,100-barrel-per-day coastal refinery will be shut down for about one month, the official said from Fujian.
"We haven't finalised the starting date but it will be at the beginning of April. This is a scheduled shutdown we do every year," said the official.
As reported, the southeastern Zhenhai refinery's 75,000-bpd crude unit will be down in March.
